stuck_loop: Diagnose: read the failing check log (gh run view --log-failed) and say which gate failed and why, in one sentence.
Reproduce: run the same command locally on a clean worktree off origin/main, never on a shared dirty checkout.
Smallest failing test: shrink it to one test or fixture that fails for the same reason, and commit it first.
Consult docs/source: the repo's own contract or config for that gate, then upstream docs at the pinned version.
Ask a teammate: post the failing test plus a hypothesis to the owning lane (table below) before widening scope.
Escalate to the owner with one specific yes/no or A/B question, the evidence path, and what each answer unblocks. Never escalate 'what should I do?'.
learn_loop: Curriculum: pick the lesson list from the lane's real source (Bootcamp yaml, study pack CARD, plan doc).

Held-out eval: a holdout the learner never saw, with leakage checks and a fixed seed.
Evidence card: score, SHA, versions, run log and failures, with claimable=false until the gate passes.
Package: CP/LP/RP/DP manifest plus the license gate. Nothing is sellable without an approved_for_sale outcome and owner approval.
